content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Eating blocks my reception. I’m fasting for clarity.
I can’t support the claim that food blocks reception. What measurable changes have you noticed—concentration span, sleep, heart rate?
More lightheaded, but I can focus longer on signals.
Lightheadedness aligns with low intake. Tracking sleep hours, step count, and resting heart rate can separate sensation from signal.
So the fasting itself might be altering perception.
A day with regular meals versus a fasting day, compared side by side, would make differences visible.
That gives a starting dataset if you want to review patterns later.
